notes: Fetch only the selected municipality dataset; every shard remains PR1 EvaluationDataset-compatible.
Evaluation-record counts are not universally deduplicated municipal project counts.
searched_not_found means no eligible result in the bounded query, never unpublished.
No primary dataset path means no reviewed primary data yet; it is not evidence that the municipality has no evaluations.
Historical observations remain in their separate companion, not the primary display shards.
Composition: validated national v19 primary cohort plus the original PR1 baseline. No unavailable pending 21-city release is included.
Original PR1 source statuses, warnings, evidence, assessment years and unknowns are preserved; this does not establish whole-city or latest-year completeness.

For baseline rows marked coverageMetricsStatus=not_assessed_for_baseline, the two national coverage metrics are unassessed; their preserved zero values do not establish absence of costs or outcome indicators.
Cached-text expansion: independently identified project records only; no new source acquisition and no municipality-wide completeness claim.
Supplemental append-only overlay: original municipal assets preserved; duplicate reprints excluded; corrections require separate review.
